name: Stadium Wave Collision
promptTemplate: A packed stadium in the dark under {{palette}} lighting with {{ambient_cheer}} crowd energy, {{wave_speed}}x speed waves, {{glow_size}}px halos, and roof beams {{floodlights}}

ui.title: STADIUM WAVE +7
ui.tagline: Rally the crowd and spark collision flashes across the bowl

wave_speed.hint: Dial wave travel velocity around the rim

wave.hint: Launch paired waves clockwise and counterclockwise

flare.hint: Ignite a brilliant flare in your seat section

listing.blurb: A dark arena of thousands of glowing seats where participants trigger circulating crowd waves that detonate into brilliant flashes on collision.
listing.prompt: A packed stadium in the dark, every seat a tiny light, one section per person in the room; anyone can start a wave from their section, which rolls round the whole bowl, and waves that meet collide into a flash. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
